sourceHashNormalization: CRLF normalized to LF, matching Git source blobs
testScope: Full 589-case run; latest thin-swash source gate rechecked with all 32 affected cases afterwards.
device: Chrome WebGL2 / ANGLE AMD Radeon RX 7600 XT Direct3D11
performanceScope: One high-quality live shoreline viewpoint, with recording; not a baseline-relative optimization or all-device claim.

without-impact-foam.scope: Frozen camera/history; hides impact aeration or all surface foam. Different render cadence can affect reflection/shadow samples.

without-all-foam.scope: Frozen camera/history; hides impact aeration or all surface foam. Different render cadence can affect reflection/shadow samples.

media.source: Actual continuous Chrome canvas recording; silent, no generated or interpolated imagery

media.loop: Forward replay with a last-to-first cut, not a seamless physical cycle

limitations: Visual breaking sheets and foam closure, not volume-conserving 3D CFD
Small damped linear wake ripples, not a full dispersed Kelvin-wake solver
No new calibrated coastal photogrammetry reconstruction
